title: Workspace review admission
description: Exercise static review preview through an isolated production gateway with no device slots. Proves placement, configuration and owner checks, without launching a worker.

workspace-preview.intent: Preview records the authorized machine, slotId null, host capacity and canonical static template without creating any slot or queued work.

unsupported-placement.intent: Missing or unsupported native transport, runner, model, effort, capacity opt-in and slot-pinned requests cannot authorize workspace review.

missing-owner.intent: A gateway without a configured native owner rejects preview without allocating resources.
